name: Koi no Hisshoku Bunkatsu
source:
Her classmates were the masters of Impressionism.

The protagonist is a 19-year-old girl working part-time while dreaming of getting into art school.
Juggling jobs and life, she struggles to find time to study for the entrance exams.
One day, to clear her mind, she visits an "Impressionist & Post-Impressionist Art" exhibition—
but the moment she lays eyes on a certain painting, her vision spins… and she collapses.

When she wakes up, she’s in another world—an art school unlike any other.
Her classmates? Legendary painters of the modern era.
Van Gogh, Gauguin, Renoir, Monet, Manet, Degas…
Trapped in this strange world, she begins her life at the academy while searching for a way back home.

Through her encounters with these artists, she starts to see reflections of her own struggles.
Will she ever find her way back to the real world?

[Translated from [url=http://koihude.web.fc2.com/story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
她的同学们都是印象派大师。

主角是一名19岁的女孩，一边打工，一边梦想考入艺术学校。
她要在工作与生活之间周旋，努力挤出时间准备入学考试。
一天，为了放松心情，她参观了“印象派与后印象派艺术”展览——
但当她看到某幅画的瞬间，视野开始旋转……随后失去了意识。

醒来时，她已经身处另一个世界——一所独一无二的艺术学校。
她的同学是谁？是现代艺术时代的传奇画家。
梵高、高更、雷诺阿、莫奈、马奈、德加……
她被困在这个奇异的世界里，一边寻找回家的方法，一边开始了学院生活。

在与这些艺术家的相遇中，她开始从他们身上看到自己的挣扎。
她最终能回到现实世界吗？
